Archer.attackA: raises the {weapon}, aims to the right, shoots with a quick recoil of the arms and shoulders, then lowers the {weapon}
Archer.attackB: plants the feet wide, leans back and pulls back hard for a big charged shot aimed to the right, holds it, then releases with a strong recoil that pushes the body back a step

Mage.attackA: lunges forward and thrusts the {weapon} far forward to the right with the arm fully extended, holds it a moment, then pulls back to the ready stance
Mage.attackB: raises the {weapon} high over the head with both hands, then swings it down and forward to the right in a big arc while leaning forward, then returns to the ready stance

Brawler.attackA: steps forward and swings the {weapon} hard to the right in a wide arc, then steps back to the ready stance
Brawler.attackB: lifts the {weapon} high over the head with both hands, then slams it straight down onto the ground in front with the knees bent, then stands up again

Knight.attackA: steps forward and slashes the {weapon} down to the right, then steps back to guard
Knight.attackB: raises the shield in front, charges two quick steps forward to the right and bashes hard with the shield, then steps back to guard

Rogue.attackA: dashes forward to the right and makes two quick strikes with the {weapon}, then hops back to the ready stance
Rogue.attackB: crouches low, leaps forward to the right in a spinning flip, strikes down on landing, then hops back to the ready stance

Tamer.attackA: the kid points forward to the right, and the {weapon} companion runs forward, jumps and strikes, then runs back beside the kid
Tamer.attackB: the kid raises both arms and cheers, and the {weapon} companion charges forward fast to the right, rams hard, then bounces back beside the kid

common.idle: breathing idle in place: the chest rises and falls, a small up and down bob, the {weapon} sways a little, the feet stay planted
common.hurt: recoils hard from a hit: the whole body is knocked back to the left and leans far back, the head is thrown back, one foot lifts off the ground, then the body recovers to the ready stance
common.defeat: collapses: the knees buckle, the body falls backward and sits down hard on the ground, the head droops, dizzy, and stays seated
